author: aditsangani (AI-assisted)
summary: Add original labeled signal replay fixtures and manual ROI provenance
details: Prepare 12 synthetic cases across 18 PNG frames, original CC0-1.0 asset/annotation dedication, source/license records, hashes, authored replay sequences and bounded manual ROI metadata. Add an offline generator/verifier; no parser, model training, automatic pedestrian recognition, live transport or production state change.
validation: 31 vision tests passed including nine new fixture tests. All decoded pixels/annotations reproduced; committed asset hashes verified. First frames of all 12 cases visually inspected. Checked publishing runs shared tests, repository structure, generated changelog and whitespace validation. No real-scene accuracy or hardware evidence.
